title: Color Wheel Emotion Picker
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Interpret a color's hue, saturation, and brightness by selecting a point on a circular color wheel, and classify the resulting color as warm or cool while exploring its common emotion association.

learningObjectives: Interpret a color's hue, saturation, and brightness by selecting a point on a circular color wheel, and classify the resulting color as warm or cool while exploring its common emotion association.
